subject: dsa
title: Daily Temperatures
summary: Keep a stack of days still waiting for a warmer one. Each new day pops every colder day it beats, recording the gap, so each day is pushed and popped once.
problem: For each day, how many days until a warmer temperature? Answer 0 if none comes.

steps.caption: For each day, how many days until it gets warmer? Keep a stack of days still waiting (highlighted).
Day 0 (73) has no warmer day yet, so push it; it waits.
Day 1 (74) is warmer than day 0. Day 0 waited 1 day. Day 1 now waits.
Day 2 (71) isn't warmer than day 1, so it waits too. Waiting: days 1 and 2.
Day 3 (72) beats day 2 (71): day 2 waited 1 day. But 72 < day 1's 74, so day 1 keeps waiting. Day 3 waits.
Day 4 (76) beats day 3 (72): 1 day. It also beats day 1 (74): day 1 waited 3 days. Day 4 waits.
Day 4 never sees a warmer day, so its answer is 0. Final: [1, 3, 1, 1, 0].
